`BebasNeue-Regular.ttf` — Bebas Neue by Ryoichi Tsunekawa (Dharma Type), SIL Open Font License 1.1, from google/fonts `ofl/bebasneue`. Used only to test loading a TrueType file from disk.

`pyembroidery-random1.u01` — a Barudan U01 file written by pyembroidery, copied unchanged from `fixtures/embroidepy/samples.zip` (`random1.u01`). Used by `test/readers.test.js` to check the U01 reader against an external writer.
